source: User answers to 15 source-grounded questionnaires in this Codex conversation, 2026-10-04
status: Accepted product decisions; implementation and prototype outcomes tracked separately

decisions.time: Real time with pause; default 1 real second = 1 simulation second; globally adjustable rate applies consistently to all authoritative systems. Complex menus pause. Native action costs preserved. Long activities accelerate automatically with interruption handling.
decisions.depth: deep CDDA rules; guided defaults; progressively exposed optional detail/manual control up to near-native CDDA experience
decisions.movement: Playable comparison required: smoothly presented native grid vs authoritative CDDA tile+subcell extension, natural first-person heading/stops and fractional accumulated movement costs; integrated CDDA remains ground truth. User decides after documented hands-on scenarios.
decisions.spatialPreference: Visible geometry should determine range and obstacles, conditional on a clear contract with CDDA ground truth; user requests explanation promptly.
decisions.validation: Plan playable comparison of smooth grid vs hybrid before final commitment.
decisions.groundTruth: CDDA integrated authoritative, explicit tested spatial extensions allowed. User must personally play test scenes; differences from vanilla and extensions must be well documented.

interactions.default: quick action + stable-position compact radial menu + full action list with requirements/costs; rebindable shortcuts

posture.groundTruth: speed/noise/fatigue in 3D must follow integrated CDDA authority, parameters may be adapted as necessary

vertical.initial: fluid stairs, explicit vault/climb; swimming and diving retained
vertical.pending: Resolved: native contextual jumps and acquired leaps included; effective ordinary jump cost remains a code-path/test investigation.
vertical.jump: Include native contextual gap jumps, vaulting and acquired leap abilities with original eligibility constraints; verify ordinary ledge-jump effective cost (no explicit moves charge in success branch) before any adaptation; no unrestricted universal physics jump assumed.

inventory.view: unified icons/categories/search; actual pocket/container shown for selected item; advanced tree view
inventory.transfers: select quantities between two panels while paused, then execute native-like interruptible timed activity; prioritize CDDA behavior

decisions.survival: Full CDDA mechanics, guided main indicators, details on demand; no per-world rule disabling selected.
decisions.equipmentVisuals: Recognizable equipment categories and colors for first complete version; canonical per-item stats and clothing layers remain complete.

medical.ui: body diagram -> explicit actual item -> confirm treatment; original item -> body workflow also available
medical.help: filter relevant owned items and explain knowable effects; no automatic treatment selection or automatic care plan

crafting.recipes: visual known-recipe catalogue; linked known subrecipes; user starts each job; batch quantities/favorites; no automatic dependency production queue
crafting.components: explicit confirmation of proposed concrete components and source containers; alternatives editable; protect favorite/equipped items from automatic selection
crafting.longActivities: automatic time acceleration with progress; pause on relevant interruptions; user can slow/stop; full CDDA simulation advances

combat.defense: native passive defenses, martial techniques and positional movement; no new universal active parry/dodge mechanic
combat.time: auto-pause on newly perceived threat; user resumes real-time; manual pause available
combat.optionalTurnMode: User requests selectable action-by-action combat if design/implementation is reasonably simple; validate shared-scheduler feasibility in time/movement prototype, not promised yet.
combat.ranged: assisted default and selectable free-crosshair mode required in first complete version, same CDDA ballistic and aim-time authority

perception.awareness: Preserve CDDA perception independent of camera field of view, contextual directional awareness cues; no new vision-cone balance change now.
perception.sound: spatial audio + optional discreet descriptions/directional cues with canonical uncertainty
perception.maps: Confirmed native world map, notes/routes, graphic minimap default true in pinned CDDA; adopt consultable world/local knowledge views plus optional minimap. Local dedicated map is 3D adaptation of native overhead information, no item access requirement.

creatures.coverage: Preserve base CDDA bestiary with family models, size/appearance cues for distinguishable variants; improve individual assets later.
creatures.simulation: CDDA AI, evolution, special attacks and native warnings; presentation assets only from Mineclonia
creatures.corpses: manual actions by default; native automation optional; retain revival, destruction, butchery/dissection costs and requirements

npcs.dialogue: paused panel with complete native text/history/responses/trials and consequences
npcs.trade: native multi-item bilateral barter/credit/ownership/capacity with explicit final confirmation
npcs.companions: quick native orders + readable profiles + editable full native individual rules; obey communication constraints
npcs.missions: Native journal/status/deadlines/selected mission/destination and map direction retained; optional first-person HUD direction is presentation adaptation, no more precise target than native exposes. Exact time vs approximate preserves watch-dependent knowledge.
npcs.camps: include native camps, expeditions, resources, jobs and upgrades through management panel; preserve native offscreen abstractions

building.granularity: Native CDDA structures represented in 3D, preview and authoritative validity; no arbitrary per-render-voxel construction extension requested.
building.planning: Multi-cell plans/blueprints with material estimates; native staged interruptible labor
building.logistics: Native sorting/farming/building zones presented spatially; actual workers and native activities perform work
building.appliances: Native appliance/electrical systems with clear device/network UI, hiding internal vehicle implementation

vehicles.driving: Playable comparison of interpolated native driving and continuous authoritative CDDA extension; user chooses after driving/collision/skill scenarios.
vehicles.workshop: In-world targeting + layered part view; full native installation/repair/removal requirements and timed work
vehicles.rollout: Plan native categories in sequence land, water, then flight; flight included later, not excluded.

progression.characterCreation: guided presets/filters plus full native creation editor, scenarios, professions, backgrounds, attributes and skills
progression.skills: native distinction practice/theory/proficiencies; books and NPC training preserved
progression.mutationsBionics: both full core native systems including costs, risks, activation and physical/equipment implications; unified readable character/ability UI

worldActivities.farmingAnimalsFood: Retain native farming/harvesting/fishing/foraging/animal care and mounts, butchery/food prep/preservation; contextual actions, zone operations and native timed activities.
worldActivities.environment: Native fire/smoke/gas/weather/traps/destruction rendered consistently; no knowledge leak.
worldActivities.liquids: Native CDDA sources/containers/transfers/fuel/swimming and native phenomena with 3D visuals; no new voxel fluid simulation
worldActivities.computers: Readable menu/panel exposing native functions, skill checks, times and consequences; no new reflex minigame

worldProfile.default: Pinned CDDA developer-recommended valid mod profile (dda plus no_npc_food, personal_portal_storms, no_fungal_growth; resolve invalid/legacy identifiers as native loader does). Expose exact mod/config list; advanced native settings editable.
worldProfile.expansions: Complete/verify base first; selected large content mods later with explicit compatibility coverage and tests; retain generic ability/EOC infrastructures.
worldProfile.deathSave: Native quicksave/load/autosave and permanent character death; expose/configure native world-end policy at world creation. No added post-death recovery mode selected.

decisions.questionnaireStatus: First series complete: 15 topic blocks. Remaining product choices intentionally assigned to hands-on movement/driving prototypes; optional action-by-action combat requires feasibility validation. No repository edits made in Plan Mode.
